crossRefs.note: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.
For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”
Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land…
and Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.
In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were…
For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never…
Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.” ’ ”
“Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah…
The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her…
The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his…
For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.

Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain…
For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on…
and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because…
“But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall…
The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.
Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens…

translations.web: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
translations.bsb: For the fortified city lies deserted— a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken. There the calves graze, and there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.
translations.kjv: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches
translations.asv: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
